data.summary_en: VeriEvolve first synthesizes executable evaluators as a frozen fitness signal for tool-using agents' self-improvement, revising the evaluator between rounds with counterfactual test cases; on 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, external validation success rate rises from 6/30 to 18/30 for GLM-5.2 and 27/30 to 30/30 for Claude.
